name: Getting Started
summary: Get the crashed ship's systems running again.

steps.text: Put out the three fires at the crash site with water.

dialogue.speaker: Logbook
dialogue.text: Hull breach. Fires spreading. Suppress them before the core cells go.

steps.text: Find the Master Battery the crash threw clear of the ship.

dialogue.speaker: Logbook
dialogue.text: Fires out. Master cell missing from its bay: ejected on impact. Its locator still pings, close by. Recover it.

steps.text: Install the Master Battery in the Power Core in engineering.

dialogue.speaker: Logbook
dialogue.text: Cell recovered. Seat it in the Power Core: engineering, aft of the crew quarters.

outro.speaker: Logbook
outro.text: Power restored. Logbook online. Proceed to the Workshop.
